priorityList: Always maintain Combo Strikes by never casting the same ability twice in a row.
Cast Invoke Xuen the White Tiger on cooldown, ideally paired with trinkets and potions.
Cast Zenith while Invoke Xuen the White Tiger is active, during Bloodlust, or whenever Rising Sun Kick is on cooldown in multi-target situations.
Cast Celestial Conduit if Zenith is active and your primary abilities (Rising Sun Kick, Fists of Fury, Strike of the Windlord) are on cooldown.
Cast Fists of Fury on cooldown, especially while Master of Harmony buffs (Heart of the Jade Serpent) are active.
Cast Whirling Dragon Punch whenever available (requires both Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury to be on cooldown).
Cast Strike of the Windlord on cooldown, prioritizing windows where Zenith or Master of Harmony buffs are active.
Cast Rushing Wind Kick on cooldown.
Cast Rising Sun Kick on cooldown to enable Whirling Dragon Punch, even in AoE scenarios.
Cast Touch of Death on any valid low-health target unless Zenith is active.
Cast Spinning Crane Kick when Dance of Chi-Ji is active, provided you don't have multiple stacks of Combo Breaker to spend.
Cast Blackout Kick if you have a Combo Breaker proc or to spend Chi if Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick are unavailable.
Cast Tiger Palm if you have less than 4 Chi and are nearing maximum Energy.
In mass AoE (5+ targets), prioritize Spinning Crane Kick as a filler over Blackout Kick if Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury are on cooldown.
Use Arcane Torrent if you are low on Chi and Energy to maintain momentum.
